explanation: The E138K mutation at position 138 does not directly contact efavirenz and is located ~43 Å away from the ligand, placing it far outside the NNRTI-binding pocket. The negligible change in binding free energy (ΔΔG ≈ 0 kcal/mol) indicates this mutation has essentially no mechanistic impact on efavirenz binding, suggesting E138K is either a neutral variant or potentially a compensatory mutation that maintains overall RT folding and catalytic competence without affecting inhibitor recognition. The structural data does not support a resistance mechanism for this particular mutation against efavirenz.
